newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI council meeting starts, no comment on agenda.
newsitem.headline: EMI council meeting starts, no comment on agenda.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute Council's regular monthly meeting began soon after 0900 GMT on Tuesday at the EMI headquarters in Frankfurt, an EMI spokeswoman said.
The EMI did not comment further on the agenda for the meeting and said it did not plan to release any further information.
The spokeswoman said the meeting would end at some time in the afternoon, but that there was no fixed timetable for the talks.
The official council meeting generally runs through to 1500 GMT but bilateral talks often take place between individual council members for some time afterwards.
The EMI Council comprises 15 European Union central bank governors and EMI President Alexandre Lamfalussy.
